steps: Peel and dice onion; mince garlic and fresh ginger; trim and chop zucchini into rough chunks.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened.
Stir in turmeric and cumin; cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add zucchini, drained cooked lentils, coconut milk, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer; cook for 12 to 15 minutes, until zucchini is very tender.
Use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup, leaving some texture.
Stir in lemon juice and ladle into bowls.
Makes 4 family portions; refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
